thread:
niya: Following up on the midnight throughput/latency incident. Summary: dedicated inference pool hit a cascading queue backlog during a client burst, causing p95 to cross SLO and we consumed ~20% error budget in ~25m. We need owners on remediation, dashboard coverage, and an SLO concession for the route group /batch.
omar: I'll own infra remediation. Hypothesis: large multi-request batches + slow worker drain increased headroom pressure. Plan: reduce max_batch_bytes, enable faster worker spin-up, and add measurement hooks. Will open infra PR today.
felix: I'll handle alerts & dashboards. Adding: per-pool queue depth, error-budget burn-rate, worker spin-up latency. Also will add a recurring anomaly detector to flag sudden queue growth. PR by tomorrow morning.
tara: Regarding the SLO: propose scoped change for /batch P95 from 280ms -> 500ms for 48h tied to prod rollout. Must include rollback predicate: if error-budget burn-rate > 150% over rolling 15m, revert and page SRE. I can approve once canary metrics are green.
ops-bot: Incident record: INC-2026-0318-09 linked: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/2026-03-18-throughput-backlog-cascade
omar: quick commands I used:
```
# queue depth per node
curl -s http://metrics.internal/pool/queue_depth | jq .
# show pod lifecycle events
kubectl get events -n inference --sort-by=.lastTimestamp | tail -n 50
```
omar: Found scaling lag ~75s between trigger and new pod ready. Reducing scale threshold + faster spinup should help. Testing in staging now.
felix: Added a panel for top offending client IDs so we can throttle noisy tenants. Also adding a rate-limit rule in the API gateway as mitigation option.
tara: Owner recap: omar -> infra PR + canary, felix -> dashboards/alerts + mitigation rules, niya -> SLO doc + schedule sync + compliance filing. Timeline: infra proposal EOD, staging canary within 24h, prod rollout + SLO window aligned with rollout.
felix: small note: instrument KV cache hit rate as well; we saw cache cold-start during the window. Adding to dashboard.
niya: I'll draft the SLO change and link canary dashboard. Sync at 19:00 UTC to review canary metrics.
ops-bot: Canary auto-rollback policy: if p95 > 600ms for >10m, rollback will be triggered automatically.
niya: Great. Checklist: [omar] infra PR & canary orchestration, [felix] dashboard & gateway mitigation PR, [tara] SLO approval + rollback monitor, [niya] SLO change doc + compliance filing. Reconvene after canary run.
